products.name: Flow Headphone & Phone Stand
products.description: A flowing, sculptural place for your headphones, with a front slot for your phone. A tidy accent for a desk, gaming setup or bedside table.

products.name: Curve Caddy Headphone Stand
products.description: Keep headphones off the desktop and pens or small tools close at hand. The curved silhouette brings a useful focal point to your workspace.

products.name: Ring Dock Headphone Stand
products.description: A bold circular stand that gives your headphones a home between listening sessions. The open ring looks considered even when your headphones are in use.

products.name: Block Hub Headphone & Phone Stand
products.description: Give your headphones, phone and pens their own places in one compact desk organizer. Angular lines suit a modern gaming or work setup.

products.name: Tower Trio Headphone & Phone Stand
products.description: One vertical station for headphones, a phone and pens. A useful choice when you want to keep a busy desk organized without a row of separate holders.

products.name: Arch Headphone Stand
products.description: A simple architectural arch for displaying and storing your headphones. Its clean lines make it easy to place beside a monitor or on a shelf.
